manualReview.summary: Deposited LepRb TRAP count source verified
manualReview.note: The official count matrix is accessible, supports control versus Stat3 knockout within LepRb TRAP samples, and was rehashed locally (source SHA-256 951a05b8...; cleaned matrix c8781814...). The open paper supplements emphasize pathway/regulator summaries and do not provide a complete same-contrast all-gene statistics table. 2026-11-15 turbo notloc1: Europe PMC OA supplement mmc1.xlsx (SHA-256 93ca2691...) Table2 provides 196 author-selected genes that are LepRb-enriched (from the 2,463 bead/sup-enriched set) and regulated in at least one STAT3KO or ob/ob comparison, with DESeq2 STAT3KO-vs-control log2 effects and an unlabelled P (raw vs adjusted not stated). The retained paper full text (PMC6437596 JATS XML, SHA-256 24364c77...) states DESeq2 on Ensembl v94 protein-coding genes with no threshold for genotype-regulated genes, and pooling of hypothalami from 5-8 mice per TRAP replicate (the Table 2 legend says 4-6). 188 pair by exact symbol with the registered edgeR-QL output: Pearson 0.99931, Spearman 0.99978, nonzero direction agreement 99.47% (sole discordant gene Vwa5a, author P 0.995), 100% among 128 author P<0.05 pairs, median absolute log2FC difference 0.0125 (max 0.691, F830016B08Rik). Eight author symbols (Fam159a, Gm4951, Svs2, Trim55, Ddx58, Fam159b, Gm8773, Olfr56) were left unmatched rather than renamed. The selected table does not establish full-universe agreement, and DESeq2 versus edgeR-QL inference is not reconciled. Evidence and reproducible extraction (xlsx2tsv.py, make_author_effects.py, compare_table2.py) are in continued-sources/GSE123983/turbo-2026-11-15-notloc1/.

verificationReview.nextStep: Obtain the complete author DESeq2 table and the P-value definition before any full-coverage or inferential claim. Keep the eight unmatched author symbols unmatched rather than renaming them to raise coverage.

comparabilityReview.basis: Registered edgeR-QL bead-fraction result against the author's selected Supplemental Table 2 STAT3KO-vs-control effects.
comparabilityReview.reference: PMC6437596 Supplemental Table 2 (196 genes) from mmc1.xlsx, retrieved via the Europe PMC OA bundle and hashed on 2026-11-15.

cohort.note: GEO series matrix maps three Stat3KO bead and three Ctrl bead libraries to the registered case/control. Each TRAP replicate pools hypothalami from 5-8 mice (paper Methods 2.5; the Table 2 legend says 4-6 animals). Author Table 2 also involves separate ob/ob comparisons not in this series; author sample membership for the KO-vs-control test is inferred from GEO, not stated per sample.

contrast.note: STAT3KO minus control within LepRb TRAP bead fractions; same orientation (Agrp +1.85 author, +1.84 registered).

features.note: 188 of 196 author symbols pair exactly; eight older or unmatched symbols left unmatched without renaming. Author universe restricted to protein-coding genes (Ensembl v94).

effects.note: Pearson 0.99931, Spearman 0.99978, median absolute log2FC difference 0.0125, max 0.691 on 188 pairs. Author DESeq2 shrinkage status not stated.

inference.note: Author P column is not labelled raw or adjusted; 128 paired genes have author P<0.05 (all direction-concordant) and 76 paired genes have registered FDR<0.05. Calls were not reconciled.

coverage.note: Table 2 rows are LepRb-enriched genes (from the 2,463 bead/sup-enriched set) that are regulated in at least one STAT3KO or ob/ob comparison, so the reference is narrower than a regulated-gene list. The narrative's 243 regulated enriched genes differ from the 196 rows. Full tested universe unavailable.

comparabilityReview.criteria: Exact-symbol pairing only; finite effects; no threshold or mapping tuning. Selected-gene references remain scoped and cannot confer full verification.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: Selected author effects agree closely with the registered output in direction and magnitude. Inference and full-universe coverage remain unestablished.
